newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales light at $62 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sales light at $62 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Confirmed - 2,500 Last week - 36,500 Year Ago - None
WK to date - 87,100 Last week - 67,400 Year Ago - 21,200
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 61.00-62.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 61.00- 62.00. Pen Utility and Choice 2-4 1200 lbs including heiferettes 60.00.
Sales reported on 1,600 slaughter steers and 900 heifers; 87,100 head confirmed for week to date which includes 25,600 formulated and 100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
